test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b58395a874d3a4364eb068c036c1a22fd98ee92967582b60a7b0f8b1141870e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Letter 'M' is shifting Northeast direction, again shifting in South direction and again shifting in Northwest direction, again shifting in Northeast direction with water image in the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1faaaadac298b6a0fa06571f275e434ae6e26283701dc65a010b40326ab12dff.png] 

Step II: Symbol '+' is shifting in South direction and again shifting in Northwest direction, again shifting in Northeast direction, again shifting in South direction with water image in the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07f38a40e7ddc67c041829a31565b20a312a4dd6c08800e3e7217a5e0a2f036.png] 

Step III: Letter 'S' shifting in Northwest direction, again shifting in Northeast direction, again shifting in South direction and again shifting in Northwest direction with water image in the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/237a80f11c88fc197834eb34d122d2d854862ba17f0d02c5178a1880e82358cb.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e18cd8526494f070566fa23575e567d4872b30690329b664760b6783670a3dc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
